title: Dog at Computer
description: A brown dog wearing a collar sits at a wooden desk, typing on a keyboard with its paws while looking at an Apple iMac monitor. The screen displays the word "coffee" in large orange letters, with a white mug and mouse also visible on the desk.
prompt: A brown dog with a collar sitting upright at a wooden desk, using its paws to type on a keyboard in front of an Apple iMac computer. The monitor screen shows the word coffee in large orange letters on a white background. A white coffee mug and silver mouse sit on the desk to the left. The dog is focused on the screen, side view, in a cozy indoor setting with soft lighting, digital painting style.
